en: A black‑and‑white view of a tree‑lined promenade or square with people walking in early 20th‑century clothing. At the right stands a large statue of a man in a dynamic pose on a tall pedestal inscribed with the word "PETOFI." Behind the statue is a grand multi‑storey historicist building with ornate windows and roofline. The foreground shows a cobbled street with chain posts separating the roadway from the promenade.
